purpose: Teach: オマケ/脳みそ/右肩/負け犬/ペースト/方角/かわし/ひきこもり

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫にオマケを買って下さった
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he used to buy little treats for the grandchildren.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Gentle start on the question. Slow, careful pacing like turning pages in an old album. Voice trails into the image itself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、晩年も脳みそはお元気だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and even in his later years, your grandfather kept that sharp mind of his, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming nod in the voice. Slight lift of fondness on the detail about his mind. Conversational, intimate — speaking to him as much as answering him. Trailing acknowledgment at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが右肩に傷を負われた
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he got a wound on his right shoulder.
lines.style: Same wistful register, but quieter now — something heavier in the memory. Pause before the injury detail. Voice softens around the wound itself, almost protective of the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦中、負け犬扱いされぬ誇りをお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather — even during the war, he held his pride. Never let them make him feel like a failure, did he, dear?
lines.style: Steady, grounded conviction underneath the tenderness. A gentle correction — reframing what could have broken him. Voice firms slightly on the word for pride. Intimate eye-contact level maintained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お母さんが味噌をペースト状に練られた
lines.en: Gran — when your mother was young, she used to knead miso into paste with her own hands.
lines.style: Same gentle reaching-back tone. Slight warmth on the domestic detail — a mother's hands working. Slower on the kneading motion, as if the voice itself is pacing that repetitive care.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、方角を見て家を建てられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather — he looked at the direction of the land and built the house just right, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Admiring undertone. Voice lifts slightly on the detail of his skill and foresight. Warm, confirming — she's remembering his competence. Soft close on the familiar endearment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが矢をかわして難を逃れた
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he dodged arrows and escaped danger.
lines.style: Wistful but with an undercurrent of worry — the danger is real in the memory. Quick, sharp attack on the action words, then softens. Voice carries the relief that he made it through.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ひきこもりがちな若者を諭されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather — he reached out to those young people who kept to themselves, guided them with his words, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm pride in his character. Gentle lift on the kindness he showed. Voice closes softly, almost murmuring the final endearment — intimate, appreciative, a small exhale of affection at the end.
